home.heroDescription: Professional landscaping and garden maintenance services in British Columbia. We bring your dream garden to life.

about.story: Najm Garden & Maintenance started with a simple goal—to help people keep their outdoor spaces beautiful and stress-free. With a passion for landscaping and years of experience, we built a company that values hard work, reliability, and quality service. From small gardens to large yards, we treat every project with care, making sure your outdoor space looks its best. Whether it's lawn care, trimming, planting, or cleanups, we're here to help. We believe a great yard brings joy, and we're proud to be a part of that. Let's grow something amazing together!
